mod_predicates.effective_weight: first matching spawn_weight * first matching generation_weight / 100; missing spawn=0, missing generation=100
mod_predicates.eligible_if: effective_weight > 0 for at least one retained non-influenced base profile

tier_derivation: Within exact base profile, affix generation, ordered groups, type, ordered stat IDs: descending distinct required_level rank. Ties remain multiple IDs and are explicitly flagged; NOT official displayed tiers. Derive before applying requested item level so ranks do not renumber on low-level items.
